title: Formal Email Phrases in Order
description: Construct key formal email phrases for openings, attachments, inquiries, and professional sign-offs.

items.sentence: Thank you for your prompt response to my email.
items.translation: Obrigado por sua resposta rápida ao meu e-mail.

items.sentence: I am writing to inquire about the job position.
items.translation: Estou escrevendo para me informar sobre a vaga de trabalho.

items.sentence: Please find attached the requested document.
items.translation: Segue em anexo o documento solicitado.

items.sentence: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have questions.
items.translation: Por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato caso tenha dúvidas.

items.sentence: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
